Pure CI/tooling release — no `app/` changes, nothing for operators to act on. Follow-up fixes after v0.5.11 became the first release actually cut through the new automation and surfaced a few bugs only a real run could catch.

### Fixed
- **Release SBOM only covered amd64 packages** — `docker-publish.yml`'s "Generate SBOM (CycloneDX)" step scanned the multi-arch manifest-list digest; with no `--platform` flag, Trivy silently resolves that to the scanning host's architecture (amd64 on the runner), so any arm64-only package or version difference was invisible in the SBOM attached to GitHub Releases. Now generates and attaches one SBOM per platform, each scanning that platform's own single-platform digest
- **`release.yml` missed a squash-merged release commit** — a squash merge rewrites the commit subject to `release: vX.Y.Z (#NNN)`, appending the PR number; the detection regex required an exact `release: vX.Y.Z` line with nothing after it, so v0.5.11's own release PR silently no-op'd on first use. Now tolerates an optional trailing `(#NNN)`
- **`release.yml` missing `issues: write` for milestone close** — the Milestones API's PATCH endpoint is grouped under Issues, not Contents; the workflow's explicit `permissions:` block only granted `contents: write` and `actions: write`, so "Close matching GitHub milestone" 403'd on every real release with a matching open milestone, failing the job on its last step even though tag/release/docker-publish had already succeeded
- **CHANGELOG title containing `]` broke title parsing** — `sync-release-docs.py`'s "Current release" regexes and `release.yml`'s GitHub Release title extraction both assumed a release title contains no `]`/bracket punctuation; a title quoting something like a CVE ID would silently truncate the extracted title or make `sync-release-docs.py --check` permanently unable to match its own output. Both now anchor on the known, fixed structure around the title instead of guessing where it ends

### Added
- **CI: `concurrency:` on `codeql.yml` and `dependency-review.yml`** — the last two workflows without one now also cancel/queue superseded runs, closing the final item from the governance standardization sweep (PR #129)

---

### Deploy

- `ghcr.io/solarssk/ssf-transmitter:0.5.12` / `docker.io/solarssk/ssf-transmitter:0.5.12` — same image, both registries, `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`
- Upgrade notes: [docs/Upgrading.md](https://github.com/solarssk/ssf-transmitter/blob/main/docs/Upgrading.md)
